what: When hovering a link that holds a circle button, the border ring spreads to 1.25× and fades away, a white disc (faint shadow) grows from 0 in the same spot and turns on, and the arrow in the circle exits to the right while a new arrow enters from the left (.4s cubic-bezier(.27,0,.58,1)). On leave it returns the same way. The 「glow」 type spreads a faint glow behind the whole link cell and turns on with it.

options.[data-fx-part=ring]: Circle (required) — the ring and disc are drawn by the part with ::before and ::after
options.[data-fx-part=arrow]: (if any) arrow in circle — leave empty and the part draws two sets. To use another icon change --fx-mask (external link icon, etc.)
options.--fx-size: Circle diameter (via style), default 68px — original PC 110px (max 10vw)
options.--fx-ring · --fx-disc · --fx-arrow-on: Ring color (default --kf-dim) · disc color (default --kf-surface) · arrow color after lighting (default --kf-ink)
options.look: glow: The glow spreading behind the link cell (--fx-glow, default light accent at 80%) turns on with it

use: Your details here
